answer: The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, re-queued for a second panel, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The marble of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Each submission hangs on the ridge of a task receipt, and the canyon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
